problem: The line 'When two shafts are joined in series or parallel, the torque splits or adds' is wrong for the series case. Shafts in series carry the same torque through each of them; only the angles of twist add. Torque adds only for shafts in parallel.
fix: When two shafts are joined in series, the same torque passes through both and the twists add. When they are joined in parallel, the torques add and both twist by the same angle. That is covered in 6.4.
